items.reasons: Block justified: held EO 11849 text has no own term; EO 12110 sec. 1-103(b) (held, 44 FR 1069) revokes it as a committee that 'have terminated or whose work is completed', an upper bound only. The FACA sec. 14(a)(2) two-year limit is conditional (renewal) and not a dossier evidence record. FETCH line 239 matches.

Block justified: held text sec. 3(b) 'The Committee shall terminate thirty days after submission of its report'; only the report deadline (EO 11982) is held and a deadline is not an end. EO 12110 revocation is an upper bound. FETCH line 240 matches.

Block justified: held text sec. 9 'shall terminate sixty days after the transmittal of its final report'; only the 1978-04-01 deadline is held. EO 12110 revocation is an upper bound. FETCH line 241 matches.
Block justified: held text sec. 9 'shall terminate thirty days after submitting its report'; only the 1978-03-15 deadline is held. EO 12110 revocation is an upper bound. FETCH line 242 matches.

Block justified: EO 12010 sec. 4 (held, 42 FR 52365) supersedes EO 11941 with no stated date, while sec. 3 fixes 1977-10-01 only for uniformed-services rates and a non-calendar pay-period date for the rest; whether supersession ran from signing (1977-09-28) or the effective dates is unsettled. Note: sec. 4 supersedes the whole order, so Schedules 5-7 also end with it; the open question reduces to the supersession date, but the block stands. FETCH lines 243-244 match.

Block justified: EO 9521 revocation is conditional on unheld Secretary of State regulations; EO 10697 sec. 7 revokes only 'to the extent not heretofore revoked or superseded' (1957-03-01), an upper bound. FETCH line 245 matches.

Block justified: paragraph 2 amends FSR sec. V-23 (held text line 116); its earlier displacement by a State Department regulation cannot be excluded from held sources, and EO 10697's 'to the extent not heretofore' revocation is only an upper bound. FETCH line 246 matches.

Block justified: both permissions are limited to Social Security Board personnel (held text); Reorganization Plan No. 2 of 1946 (60 Stat. 1095) abolished the Board and is not a dossier record, so the first end (1946-07-16 vs EO 11408, 1968-04-25) cannot be decided. FETCH line 247 matches with a govinfo URL.
